controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers

vote.question: [US-NH - U.S. Senate]: Chris Pappas (D) has received $62,081,553 in career campaign contributions (with $47,407,296 this cycle, alongside $22,908,631 in outside Super PAC support led by WinSenate)—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Do you vote to formally rebuke Chris Pappas for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Chris Pappas has amassed $62,081,553 in career contributions (with $47,407,296 this cycle, alongside $22,908,631 in outside Super PAC support led by WinSenate)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Chris Pappas on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $5,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-NH: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving NH dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATES OF NEW HAMPSHIRE INC (US-EIN:020432242); AMERICAN CIVIL LIBERTIES UNION FOUNDATION OF NEW HAMPSHIRE (US-EIN:020347237); 603 LEGAL AID (US-EIN:020484379); NEW HAMPSHIRE DEMOCRACY FUND (US-EIN:844003182); NEW HAMPSHIRE JUVENILE COURT DIVERSION NETWORK (US-EIN:020458455). Once the pool hits $5,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-NH with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATES OF NEW HAMPSHIRE INC (US-EIN:020432242); AMERICAN CIVIL LIBERTIES UNION FOUNDATION OF NEW HAMPSHIRE (US-EIN:020347237); 603 LEGAL AID (US-EIN:020484379); NEW HAMPSHIRE DEMOCRACY FUND (US-EIN:844003182); NEW HAMPSHIRE JUVENILE COURT DIVERSION NETWORK (US-EIN:020458455).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $5,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $5,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
